jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Contract, hybrid) — People Services / Contingent Workforce Program
jobs.description:
Company Description

Employer.com is part of a family of incredible brands alongside Flawless Recruit and Recruiter.com. Together, we provide talent acquisition services to fit the unique hiring challenges of our clients; whether building recruiting processes, attracting top talent, or payrolling contractors, we can help.

Job Description

Our client is seeking a sharp, detail-oriented coordinator to own the day-to-day operational layer of their Contingent Workforce (CW) Program: processing worker lifecycle events in VNDLY, coordinating onboarding and offboarding logistics, and keeping data clean across systems. This person will work directly with the client's CW Program Manager and partner daily with People Services, IT, and the client's staffing and payroll vendors. This is a one-year contract and is 25% in office. Possibility to turn into a direct hire position.

What You Will Do

Process contingent worker lifecycle events in VNDLY: worker record creation, work orders, onboarding and offboarding tasks, extensions, assignment updates, and profile changes (including vendor-to-vendor transitions)
Own VMS record administration end to end, including new vendor setup and records currently processed by People Services
Coordinate day-one readiness for new contractors: system access requests, equipment, badge logistics, and manager communications; run offboarding checklists and confirm access termination on final days
Support the contractor onboarding experience, including the new-hire onboarding (NHO) track for contingent workers: session logistics, materials distribution, and coordination with People Services and the onboarding team
Own front-line triage across the program's intake surfaces: the CW inbox, the Jira ticket queue, and Slack requests. Answer routine questions from the CW Toolkit, resolve or route tickets with context, and keep response times inside SLA
Support finance and billing operations: chase and correct timesheets, run first-touch traces on payment and billing questions (timesheet to approval to invoice to PO), flag invoice discrepancies and coding issues in Zip, and partner with Finance and vendors through to resolution
Keep rosters reconciled across VNDLY, Workday, and vendor systems; pull data for monthly program reporting

Program Administration

Own knowledge and content hygiene: Google Drive folder organization, internal knowledge base updates, and keeping intake forms and templates current
Administer program communications: the contingent worker inbox and Google Group, distribution lists, recap posts, announcement cross-posting, and Slack channel upkeep
Support vendor management admin: collect monthly vendor metrics into the program scorecard, schedule QBRs, and track vendor action items through to the next agenda

Qualifications

2+ years in HR operations, staffing/recruiting operations, or program coordination
Experience with a VMS or HRIS (VNDLY, Workday, Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar) strongly preferred
Organized and detail-oriented, with excellent professional judgment; will manage time-sensitive and critical processes related to compensation, performance, and compliance, and handle worker data with accuracy and privacy
Reliable and responsive; will field time-sensitive and urgent questions from employees and the client's People team partners
Excellent communication skills for coordinating with cross-functional partners
Able to manage multiple deadlines and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, shifting-priority environment
Customer service-oriented; treats internal teams as "clients" and takes a flexible, creative approach to problem-solving
Fluent in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets) and Slack
Interest in using automation and AI to improve day-to-day processes
Staffing industry or contingent workforce program experience is a plus

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
NOW Hiring

Patient Care Coordinator
Front Desk Doctors of Physical Therapy is seeking a full-time Patient Care Coordinator for our Stratford clinic. Ideal candidate will be seeking longevity with a growing company, be a self-starter, should possess excellent interpersonal skills and customer service skills, this is important in order to build relationships with patients and the community in order to provide a welcoming environment. Responsibilities include; Greet patients Effectively communicate patients, families, team members, clinicians and all departments. Provides detailed instructions to patients for their visits. Reviews and evaluates patient charts for data entry accuracy. Work as a team to ensure we have an efficient working environment to ensure that calls are made timely to patients and referral sources. Familiarity with Outpatient Rehabilitation/Medical services and medical terminology. Answering phones Patient registration/data entry Scanning/faxing/other clerical duties Collecting copay's and patient balances Patient scheduling-Schedule Management Patient Care assistance as needed Strong organizational skills Knowledge of Insurance benefits Must be available to work Monday through Friday and potentially a few very early evenings. Benefits: 401k Paid Time Off Paid Holiday Time Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
HSA option health Plan HSA Life Insurance, STD & LTD, Critical Illness, Accident and Hospital Indemnity

jobs.title: Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description

Job Purpose:

Ensuring seamless patient care by coordinating medical services and addressing patient needs.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

Actively engage with clients to promote wellness and preventive care. This involves educating them on the importance of regular check-ups, screenings, vaccinations, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.
Collaborates with healthcare providers to develop personalized care plans that prioritize wellness and prevention for each client.
Conducts health assessments and screenings to identify potential health risks and recommend preventive measures.
Coordinates screenings for conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, cancer, or infectious diseases based on client or population needs.
Provides resources and information on wellness-related topics, wellness program, and services.
Coordinates referrals to specialists, preventive services, based on client needs.
Ensures seamless communication between healthcare providers to optimize client care and follow-up.
Serves as a central point of contact between clients, healthcare providers, and other healthcare professionals.
Facilitates effective communication, ensure proper documentation, and support smooth transitions of care.
Regularly monitor client progress in following preventive care plans, including adherence to recommended screenings and interventions.
Follows up with clients to address any barriers, provide support, and reinforce the importance of preventive care.
Builds relationships with community partners to expand access to preventive care resources and programs.
Maintains accurate and comprehensive records of client interactions, care plans, and outcomes.
Prepares reports and documentation as required by healthcare regulations and to gauge the effectiveness of wellness and preventative services.
Be flexible to work between different sites.
Performs other duties as assigned to support Wellness Aim & Objective.

All Fakeeh Care employees are responsible for continuous improvement, including:

Performing all duties and tasks in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person-Centered care values.
Actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, within the scope of the role.
Adherence to safety protocols and proactively seeking to address any job-related safety concerns.
Maintaining strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work.
Complying with cybersecurity policies and standards to protect Fakeeh’s systems and participating in awareness training and initiatives to prevent cyber threats.
Adhering to and upholding Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies and ethical standards.
Completion of mandatory education as per the requirement, at least one month prior to expiration.

Requirements

Skills and Abilities:

Have a strong understanding of the principles and practices of preventative care, including screenings, vaccinations, lifestyle modifications, and health promotion.
Stays updated on current guidelines and best practices related to wellness and preventative services.
Demonstrates excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with clients, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders.
Be able to explain complex medical concepts in a clear and concise manner and build rapport with a diverse range of clients.
Possesses experience in care planning and coordination, including assessing client needs, developing clientized care plans, and coordinating services across multiple healthcare providers.
Understands the importance of continuity of care and have the ability to navigate through healthcare systems.
Have the ability to motivate and educate clients on the importance of preventive care.
Exhibits strong organizational and time-management skills to effectively prioritize tasks, manage caseloads, and ensure timely follow-up with clients and healthcare providers.
Have the ability to handle multiple responsibilities and work within established protocols and guidelines.
Possesses the capacity to gather, analyze, and interpret data related to wellness and preventative services.
Uses data to identify trends, evaluate program effectiveness, and make informed decisions to enhance care delivery and outcomes.
Be culturally sensitive and aware of the diverse backgrounds and healthcare needs of clients.
Understands the impact of cultural factors on healthcare decision-making and be able to provide equitable and client-centered care.
Be proficient in using electronic health records, care coordination software, and other technology platforms commonly used in healthcare settings.
Have a good understanding of health information privacy.
Works well within interdisciplinary teams, collaborating effectively with healthcare providers, community organizations, and other stakeholders to coordinate care and promote wellness.
Possesses strong teamwork skills to foster a culture of cooperation and shared goals.

Experience

Proven work experience of at least three years as a clinical coordinator or similar role in a healthcare organization.

Education

Possess a bachelor's degree in a healthcare-related field such as nursing, public health, health education, or healthcare administration.
Additional certifications or training in care coordination, client engagement, or wellness programs would be advantageous.

Language

Excellent command of oral and written English and prefer Arabic.

Licenses / Certifications

Possess valid registration and classification from the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties.
